name: Mark Gally
headline: Advisor | Former CEO | SaaS Executive
about:
Senior Executive with over 25 years experience (15 years working in Silicon Valley) leading SaaS and software companies. Demonstrated experience founding and managing marketing, sales, and service organizations for high-growth companies in business applications, analytics and IT infrastructure. Experience scaling organizations from less than $2MM in annual sales to over $50MM. Equally adept in established companies.

Specialties: Executive leadership, product positioning, inbound marketing, sales management, lead generation, analyst relations, business development and PR.

experiences.position: HCM, Vice President of Sales and Marketing
experiences.description:
Led global sales and marketing for Human Capital Management (HCM) product line.  Successfully integrated TribeHR’s sales, marketing, service and support organizations into NetSuite.

Drove 543% y/y joint HR/ERP monthly sales while delivering 257% y/y total monthly sales.

Established, developed and led global sales, marketing, service and support organizations.

Delivered 1,100% sales and 470% customer growth.  Received unsolicited offer that resulted in the largest transaction in the history of the acquirer.

Developed and led worldwide marketing activities including company positioning, sales enablement, lead generation, field marketing, PR and analyst relations.

Delivered 360% sales growth over 24 months by repositioning company to focus on core markets.  Drove over 60% of marketing qualified leads through inbound marketing in a traditional, channel driven industry.  Cultivated and managed strategic investor relationship leading to successful C round investment.

Established, developed and led global marketing activities including company positioning, sales enablement, analyst relations, PR, field marketing and lead generation throughout tenure.  

Grew annual sales from less than $2MM to over $50MM while maintaining profitability and without any outside funding.  Designed category’s first pre-built workflows, establishing Merced Systems as industry innovator and leader.  Launched user conference, establishing 90% participant close rate.

Managed Siebel Analytics marketing and product marketing efforts in high growth segments including Siebel Call Center, Manufacturing and Pharmaceutical Sales product lines.

Helped establish Siebel Analytics as the 2nd largest and fastest growing product in the Siebel portfolio.  Developed initial product positioning for Siebel’s first integration application (Siebel EAI) and revitalized partnership with largest communications partner.

First Consulting Manager in Pacific Northwest Region, responsible for all post sales consulting and account management activities while supporting regional sales activities through proof of concept deployments, technical reviews and development meetings.  

Managed 20 active accounts generating over $9MM in product and service revenue.  Developed new service offerings leading to a 400% increase in quarterly service revenues.  Redefined organizational structure to support 100% annual sales and headcount growth.
